summary: Defines domain-based service names and a matching name type for GSS-API, and covers internationalization of the API. A domain-based name identifies a service by the domain it serves, which helps clients authorize clustered servers even when service discovery is not secure. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Instead of trusting a single server's name, you trust whoever serves your company's domain. That way a fake helper found by an unsafe search is easier to spot.
